items.title: Four properties of module maps that descend to a finite stage of a colimit
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects four descent statements for maps of modules along a directed colimit: equality of two maps, surjectivity, the existence of a map from a finitely presented module, and being an isomorphism, all descend to a single stage (statement lines 32205-32230). The proof does not use a categorical presentability theorem: it spreads the finitely many generators or relations out to one index, uses a finite presentation of the target to build the map on a stage, and combines the parts (proof lines 32232-32275). The finite presentation of the target is exactly what makes part (3) possible. H2.
